Method of Attack: Remote code execution with SYSTEM privileges via Windows Print Spooler service vulnerability
Exploitation of zero-day vulnerability in Windows Print Spooler service
Discoverer: Chinese security company Sangfor (accidental PoC leak)
Impacted Systems: Windows clients and server platforms with Print Spooler enabled
Attack Vector: Exploitation of Windows Print Spooler service vulnerability
Remote code execution via network access to vulnerable Print Spooler service
Indicators of Compromise: PrintNightmare detection and remediation information on GitHub by Lares
Video exploit demonstration by mimikatz developer Benjamin Delpy
